description: A whole month of the Moon: every phase with its UTC minute, every sign ingress, every void-of-course period with its last aspect, and for each day the phase, illumination, lunar day and position at noon UTC. Computed live from the ephemeris (astronomy-engine, about 1′), tropical zodiac on the true ecliptic of date, geocentric, UTC. Astronomical positions only, no interpretation. Paid tool: $0.01 per call in USDC on Base via x402 (HTTP 402 with payment requirements; retry with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Free tools cover the current status and the next retrograde.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM, 1900–2100. Defaults to the current month.
